newsitem.title: CHINA: Founder to invest $10 mln in Malaysia.
newsitem.headline: Founder to invest $10 mln in Malaysia.

text.p: Founder (Hong Kong) Ltd, part of China's Founder Group Corp, plans to invest $10 million over five years in a multimedia development zone in Malaysia, the Beijing Economic Daily said on Tuesday.

Founder, which was set up by Beijing Univesity, planned to buy land and set up a factory and overseas research centre at a technology park in the Malaysian state-backed "mulitimedia super-corridor", the newspaper said.
The research centre would make it easier for the Chinese computer software maker to enter the world market and would boost its competitiveness, it said.
The Malaysian government would grant Founder favourable conditions for its investment, the newspaper said without giving details.
